Definition: to ooze, i.e. distil gradually; by implication, to fall in drops; figuratively, to speak by inspiration
BiblicalUsage: 1) to drop, drip, distil, prophesy, preach, discourse; 1a) (Qal) to drop, drip; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to drip; 1b2) to drop (prophecy)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
